_comment: A turn's first_line: its prompt's first line, cut at the first newline, split on Unicode
White_Space (Go's strings.Fields), rejoined with one space and capped at 120 runes plus an
ellipsis. A prompt opening on a Quote in reply block previews the first line of the
reader's words after it that holds any, else its opening quote as 'source: passage'
(entrylog.go previewLine; prompt_quote.go splitQuotes ports message-quote.ts splitQuotes).
Hand-written: this file is the rule, not a recording of either side.
The server writes it into the session index (entrylog.go firstLineOf) and the client
derives it for a turn still in the store's window (rail-merge.ts firstLine). They must
agree, or a turn's preview changes as it pages in or out of that window.
